about: Fees and decision times for the work permit routes in work.json, and for visitor visas by destination, researched on November 14, 2026 (the owner's command of that day: research, then estimate); and for electronic travel authorizations by destination (authorizations; passports lists the passports whose authorization differs), researched on November 16, 2026 (Morocco, Russia and Saudi Arabia later that day). Each entry names its source and whether it is the government's own page (official) or another publication (secondary). days is calendar days, or [shortest, longest] where the source gives a range; stayDays is how long the permission lasts at most, where the source says.
